deliverable_markdown.description: Full deliverable content in Markdown. Maximum 256 KiB (≈ 262 144 bytes).

deliverable_summary.description: One-line human-readable summary (≤ 280 Unicode code points). Shown in the buyer's dashboard.

structured_output.description: Optional machine-readable output (any JSON object). Accepted but NOT yet persisted — do not put anything here that isn't also in the markdown.

artifacts.description: A2A assignments only: protocol Artifact objects handed back to the A2A caller verbatim. Omit it and the markdown is wrapped as one artifact.
